rows: Manually configured relationships between a person (owner) and any number of other people
Is used for testing the check-in system when there are no events occurring.
Used to track groups that serve in the organization.
Holds a hierarchy of small groups for a particular segment.
A group of people who share an interest and meet together with regular frequency.
Used to track groups that do not warrant their own group type.

A generic group type used by specific features in Rock. Groups of this type are not show in nav but do show up in lists and have a single 'Member' role.  For example, the PhotoRequest group is of this type.
Used for creating internal org charts for the organization.
A base group type that can be inherited from to support check in without any filters.
A group that can be used to manage a fundraising opportunity such as a mission trip or internship.
For groups used by Rock's communication tools for storing lists of people to communicate to.
Used for tracking the attendance for people who attend the 'weekend' or 'weekly' service.
Used to track groups that serve a given Campus.
Used to track individuals who have signed up for events such as short term serving projects.
Used when a DM is created from inside the external chat application.
Used when a chat shared channel is created within Rock.
